name: Second Copy
why_visit: Fabricator parts and a derelict print-yard. The second copy is never quite the keel you ordered.

bodies.name: Print Yard
bodies.blurb: A print-yard. The gantries are cold and the paper is warm.
bodies.legal: Rimward Charter print lease. The yard is derelict. The paper is still sold.
bodies.air: Shop air in the office. Vacuum in the bay.
bodies.ruins: The first bad copy, bolted to the door.

bodies.name: Stencil Moon
bodies.blurb: Stencil storage. The shapes are the inventory.
bodies.legal: The moon that holds the stencils. Scanning is the job. Taking a stencil is a lease.
bodies.ruins: A stencil that printed a keel inside out.

belt.name: Misprint Belt
belt.composition: cured misprint plate and stencil resin shed by the print-yard
belt.legal: Misprint plate. The Charter still calls it a lease.

trash.name: Bad Copies
trash.origin: Keels printed once, rejected, and left in the yard when the stencil drifted.
trash.legal: Rejected copies. Salvage rights if the factor is not reading the paper.

pocket.name: Stencil Pocket
pocket.why: A print pocket. Not a garden.

pdo.duty: Print clerk over Second Copy. The stencil is the law. Hail a keel that enters the bay.

duties: Ambush over Second Copy. Hold the bad copies until a keel comes inside 520 meters, then close.

haulers.name: Print Factor
haulers.duty: Print Factor at Second Copy. Come alongside and the factor reads which copy is yours.
